Prediction or decomposition as a long table

Source: R/tidy.R
as_tibble.bruce.Rd

One row per grid cell and day, ready for dplyr and ggplot2 (e.g. geom_raster(aes(x, y, fill = mean))).

Usage

# S3 method for class 'bruce_prediction'
as_tibble(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'bruce_decomposition'
as_tibble(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A bruce_prediction (from bruce_predict()) or a bruce_decomposition (from bruce_decompose()).

...

Unused.

Value

A tibble with the cell centre coordinates x, y (in the grid's projection) and date, plus

  • for a prediction: mean and, when posterior samples were drawn, sd and one column per quantile (q0.05, q0.95, ...);

  • for a decomposition: total, covariates, field and one column per covariate's contribution (cov_elev, ...).

Cells outside the domain are dropped.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
pred <- bruce_predict(fit, n_samples = 200)
as_tibble(pred) |>
  dplyr::filter(date == as.Date("2025-01-15")) |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x, y, fill = mean)) +
  ggplot2::geom_raster() + ggplot2::coord_equal()
} # }
